prompts.prompt: Edit target: reference scene 1. Produce finished GAME BACKGROUND CLEAN PLATE, portrait 9:16, same painted cartoon dark fairy-tale style and exact composition. Keep large left framing tree, road, distant trees, dusk grey sky, stones and right wooden lamp post. Remove hanging lantern including chain and its local bright halo, leave empty wooden support. Remove orange distant ritual fire and its glow behind left distant treeline, replace with neutral dim blue-grey sky so a separate animated fire layer can be inserted there. On a low roadside stone at left middle around (24% width,49% height), add a small scratched worn arrow pointing right, low contrast, old handmade mark; not a glowing UI arrow. No moon, no buildings added. Keep background softer than foreground. No text no HUD no people creatures. Original geometry/framing unchanged.

Remove the hanging lamp and chain from left wooden post (leave empty support for separate Spine lantern). Remove the dark blurred close-up foliage/mushrooms at very bottom frame, replace with continuation of ground; foreground is a separate asset. Preserve all middle-distance mushrooms, trees, rocks and dusk-blue color. Water should have a subdued dark blue base, without bright white foam streaks, as separate animated water strokes will be layered on. Portrait9:16; no HUD, no words, no new objects.

REMOVE MOON COMPLETELY including eyelashes and glow, fill plain dark midnight sky; separate moon rig will be placed here. Remove hanging lamp and chain at left bridge support but preserve support. Remove very near blurred bottom-corner foliage, fill its place with continuation of stream and banks. Preserve bridge deck and near railing intact (separate foreground rail will overlay). Keep waterfall, stream and distant cottage in EXACT same positions and sizes. Remove both lanterns and chains, left tree lantern and right of door lantern; keep attachment brackets. Remove the very near blurred bottom leaves so near foliage can be separate overlay. No smoke in base sky (separate animation later). Keep attic lit amber diamond lattice WINDOW. No wolf in base window. Keep creek entering from upper left then EXIT LEFT EDGE AT MID HEIGHT, NO WATER in lower half, no bridge. Water is subdued still-blue base without bright streaks, animated highlights separate. Keep large trees and cottage unchanged. No mushroom buildings, no mushrooms added, no text, no HUD. Dark fairy tale cartoon painterly game background portrait9:16.

Precise edit of scene5 reference. Finished production background clean plate for dark fairy tale cartoon game. Generate PRODUCTION SPRITE SHEET on true TRANSPARENT alpha, landscape 1536x1024, strict 4 columns x2 rows EQUAL cells, each isolated prop centered inside its cell with generous transparent padding; no touching cell borders, no labels or grid lines. All 8 objects fully contained and separated. Reference only guides painted style, do not reproduce scene.

Create a single isolated warm pale-ivory full MOON DISC on true transparent alpha, matching the reference's illustrated lunar surface color, soft craters and slightly irregular painted edge. Centered circular disc with generous transparent padding all around. It will be placed behind a separate animated eyelid/eye rig. Hand-painted cartoon dark fairy tale texture, no photorealism, no words.
